cards.answer: Nami is a support mage. She heals allies, empowers their attacks and spells, and controls enemies with a bubble and tidal wave. Her abilities deal magic damage and scale with AP.
cards.counterplay: Keep space from her empowered ally and sidestep her bubble and wave.

citations.quote: Name: Nami. Official role tags: Support, Mage.
The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies.

facts.claim: She heals allies, empowers their attacks and spells, and controls enemies with a bubble and tidal wave.

citations.quote: Bonus Magic Damage Per Hit:20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80 (+ 20% AP)

facts.claim: Her abilities deal magic damage and scale with AP.

cards.priority_reason: Her ally support and crowd control define how to fight against her.

cards.answer: Surging Tides briefly speeds up allied champions hit by Nami's abilities.
cards.counterplay: Allow extra space when her abilities reach an ally who is chasing you.

citations.quote: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

facts.claim: Surging Tides briefly speeds up allied champions hit by Nami's abilities.

cards.priority_reason: The movement speed helps her allies chase or retreat.

cards.answer: Aqua Prison lands at a target location after a delay, dealing magic damage and briefly revealing and suspending enemies hit. Suspended enemies are stunned and marked as airborne.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the targeted area and avoid clustering with teammates.

citations.quote: Active: Nami launches a bubble at the target location that lands after 0.726 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and suspending them for 1.5 seconds, during which they are revealed.

facts.claim: Aqua Prison lands at a target location after a delay, dealing magic damage and briefly revealing and suspending enemies hit.

citations.quote: Suspension The target is stunned, but also marked as airborne.

facts.claim: Suspended enemies are stunned and marked as airborne.

cards.priority_reason: Landing the bubble creates a strong opportunity for follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: Ebb and Flow targets a champion or Nami herself, then bounces between nearby enemies and allies. It heals allies and deals magic damage to enemies.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from Nami and her allies to limit bounce opportunities.

citations.quote: Active: Nami unleashes a stream of water onto the target champion or herself, which then bounces to nearby champions up to twice, alternating between enemies and allies and Nami.

facts.claim: Ebb and Flow targets a champion or Nami herself, then bounces between nearby enemies and allies.

citations.quote: Ebb and Flow heals allies and deals magic damage to enemies

facts.claim: It heals allies and deals magic damage to enemies.

cards.priority_reason: The bounces let her damage enemies while sustaining her side of a trade.

cards.answer: Tidecaller's Blessing temporarily empowers Nami or an allied champion, making their next attacks or abilities deal bonus magic damage and briefly slow enemies.
cards.counterplay: Give the empowered champion space and avoid extended trades while the blessing lasts.

citations.quote: Active: Nami blesses herself or an allied champion for a few seconds, empowering their next three basic attacks or abilities to deal bonus magic damage and briefly slow enemies.

facts.claim: Tidecaller's Blessing temporarily empowers Nami or an allied champion, making their next attacks or abilities deal bonus magic damage and briefly slow enemies.

cards.priority_reason: An empowered ally can apply Nami's damage and slow through their own attacks or spells.

cards.answer: Tidal Wave travels in a target direction, dealing magic damage, briefly knocking up enemies and slowing them. The slow lasts longer as the wave travels farther. Allies hit receive an enhanced Surging Tides movement speed boost.
cards.counterplay: Move sideways out of the wave's path and give advancing allies room.
